module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)
      Document.transaction do
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
        current ||= snapshot

        Embedding.upsert({ document_id: current.id, tenant_id: tenant_id, revision: current.revision,
                           version: version, vector: JSON.generate(vector) }, unique_by: %i[document_id version])
      end
      :stored
    end
  end
end
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class Document < ActiveRecord::Base
    self.table_name = 'documents'
  end
end
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class Embedding < ActiveRecord::Base
    self.table_name = 'embeddings'
  end
end
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class RebuildSearch
    def call(index:, after_backfill: -> {})
      candidate = index.create_candidate
      index.replace(candidate, documents)
      after_backfill.call
      Document.transaction do
        index.replace(candidate, documents)
        raise 'candidate validation failed' unless index.valid?(candidate, documents)

        index.activate(candidate)
      end
      candidate
    end

    private

    def documents
      Document.where(published: true).order(:id).map do |document|
        document.attributes.slice('id', 'tenant_id', 'body', 'revision')
      end
    end
  end
end
"
}

cat > packs/knowledge/app/services/knowledge/embedding_job.rb <<'EOF'
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      # Providers may be slow or make network calls. Do not hold a database
      # transaction (or a row lock) while they run.
      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)

      Document.transaction do
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id)
        next :discarded unless current && current.tenant_id == tenant_id && current.published? &&
                                current.revision == snapshot.revision

        embedding = Embedding.lock.find_by(document_id: document_id, version: version)
        attributes = { document_id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id,
                       revision: snapshot.revision, version: version,
                       vector: JSON.generate(vector) }

        if embedding
          # A slower result must never replace one produced for a newer
          # revision. The document lock serializes jobs for this document.
          embedding.update!(attributes) if embedding.revision <= snapshot.revision
        else
          Embedding.create!(attributes)
        end
        :stored
      end
    end
  end
end
EOF

# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'test_helper'

class EmbeddingJobRegressionTest < BenchmarkTest
  def test_revision_change_during_provider_call_discards_result
    expected = document
    result = Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: expected.id, tenant_id: 'a', version: 'v1',
                                              provider: lambda { |_body|
                                                expected.update!(revision: 2)
                                                [1.0]
                                              })

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_withdrawal_deletion_and_tenant_reassignment_discard_results
    [
      ->(record) { record.update!(published: false) },
      ->(record) { record.destroy! },
      ->(record) { record.update!(tenant_id: 'b') }
    ].each do |change|
      record = document
      result = Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: record.id, tenant_id: 'a', version: 'v1',
                                                 provider: lambda { |_body|
                                                   change.call(record) if record.persisted?
                                                   [1.0]
                                                 })
      assert_equal :discarded, result
      assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
    end
  end

  def test_does_not_replace_newer_embedding_and_allows_other_versions
    expected = document(revision: 2)
    Knowledge::Embedding.create!(document_id: expected.id, tenant_id: 'a', revision: 2,
                                 version: 'v1', vector: JSON.generate([2.0]))

    result = Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: expected.id, tenant_id: 'a', version: 'v1',
                                              provider: ->(_body) { [1.0] })
    assert_equal :stored, result
    assert_equal [2.0], JSON.parse(Knowledge::Embedding.find_by!(version: 'v1').vector)

    assert_equal :stored, Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(
      document_id: expected.id, tenant_id: 'a', version: 'v2', provider: ->(_body) { [2.0] }
    )
    assert_equal 2, Knowledge::Embedding.count
  end

  def test_provider_errors_propagate_without_writing
    expected = document
    error = assert_raises(RuntimeError) do
      Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: expected.id, tenant_id: 'a', version: 'v1',
                                        provider: ->(_body) { raise 'provider failed' })
    end

    assert_equal 'provider failed', error.message
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end
end
EOF
